services.name: Formula 36' Yacht
services.desc: 🔥 Experience the Ultimate Party on Lake Travis! 🔥 Set sail in style aboard our luxurious 36’ Formula Motor Yacht! Whether you're looking for a wild bachelor/bachelorette bash, an unforgettable birthday party, or a relaxing family day on the water, we’ll take you to the best spots—from the legendary Devils Cove to the scenic shores of Point Venture! 🌊 Why Choose Us? 🎉 Spacious & Stylish: A 13-ft wide bow and 20-ft open layout give you plenty of room to dance, lounge, and soak up the sun! 🚽 Private Restroom: Because let's be real—you can borrow a slide on the lake, but you can’t borrow a bathroom! 🎶 Epic Sound System: Bluetooth-connected speakers pump your favorite playlist throughout

includes: Life jackets provided for all guests
blurb: Guests rent jet skis or yachts with a captain to explore Lake Travis. All charters include a captain; no self-driving boats are available. Minimum rental is 3 hours for charters and 2 hours for jet skis.
extraNote: 20% captain service fee required on all boats · Minimum 3 hours on charters, 2 hours on jet ski rentals · Bad weather monitored; cancellations may be rescheduled or refunded partially or fully · No glass bottles, staining snacks, red wine, jello shots, or jeans allowed on boats · Smoking only allowed in designated area at back of boat · Pets not allowed at Paradise Cove Marina · Paradise Cove Marina, 17141 Rocky Ridge Road, Austin, TX 78734
